info.title: PicDefense.io APIv2
info.description: API Documentation for PicDefense.io All endpoints require an API TOKEN in header 'X-API-TOKEN'. Your X-API-TOKEN is user id and api key seperated by a colon. Example: USERID:APIKEY Please visit the Settings page for these details.

post.summary: returns data and picrisk of an image
post.description: JSON object with image data and picrisk. Consumes 0.80 credits on success.

url.description: The URL of the image to check. Must be publicly accessible.

message.description: A message describing the outcome of the operation.

error.description: Details of any error that occurred.

url.description: The URL where the image is found.

similarity_score.description: The similarity score of the image on the page. Max 100.

backlink_count.description: The number of backlinks found for the image.

collection.description: Whether the image is part of a collection.

face.description: Whether the image contains a face.

found_at.description: The domains where the image is found.

image_url.description: The URL of the backlink image.

landmark.description: Whether the image contains a landmark.

stock.description: Whether the image is from a stock site.

your_url.description: The URL of the image on your site that you submitted for copyright risk checking.
